No 10-step ramps.

F2.evidence: role.page ({bg.page}), role.surface ({bg.wash}), role.raised ({bg.elevated}), role.overlay ({bg.elevated-wax}, the menus' fill) and role.scrim ({bg.scrim}) in both themes, all declared by the product.

F3.evidence: role.text.primary, secondary, tertiary, disabled ({text.disabled}), on-accent ({text.always-white}, the measured text of the accent button) and link ({text.link}) in both themes.

F4.evidence: role.border.default ({border.primary}), subtle ({border.secondary}), strong ({border.primary-strong}) and focus ({border.accent-primary}, the .focus-ring outline colour) in both themes.

F5.evidence: role.accent.default is {bg.accent-primary}; Devin declares no hover or pressed accent, so role.accent.hover and pressed both point at the workbench's ide.button-hoverBackground (the trust dialog's primary button); there is no distinct pressed tier.

F6.evidence: role.status.success, warning, danger and info each have fill, subtle and text from Devin's hue tokens (text.green, bg.green; text.orange, bg.orange; bg.destructive, bg.red, text.destructive; text.blue, bg.blue), but Devin has no border tier, so every status border is the hue itself, and warning and info are reassigned hues (orange, blue) rather than status tokens; under the scorecard's rule a reassigned role counts as partly.

F7.evidence: light and dark hold the same 317 token names (the builder refuses otherwise; one name read in only one theme, component.palette.border, is moved to notTokenised).

F8.evidence: Inter and Devin Mono named with their stylesheet fallback stacks (core.fontFamily), eight sizes 11 to 18 from Devin's text-NN classes with paired line heights and tracking (core.fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing), weights 400/500/600, and nine measured roles (title 18/29, section 14/20, body 13/18, label, caption 12/16, prompt 14/20, message 14/20, status, code).

F9.evidence: core.spacing: Tailwind's 4px scale, every step read from the padding and gap classes on the captured screens (1px to 80px), with the arbitrary px values in use listed in $extensions.

F10.evidence: core.radius: twelve radii read from the rounded-* classes in use (2 to 20px and full, with use counts); core.borderWidth hairline 1px and focus.

F11.evidence: core.controlHeight sm 24, base 28, lg 32 and measured controls (core.size.control.*: rows, switch, checkbox, segment, avatar, send), and the focus ring's width and offsets (core.focusRing, from .focus-ring and .focus-ring-inset). Icon sizes are not tokenised.

F12.evidence: Seven shadow tokens per theme (shadow.L1 to L4, L2-border, L4-wax, inner) as painted, with usedBy: L1 on the selected segment, chip and tooltip, L4 on menus, the palette and the toast (L3 on menus in light). L2, L2-border and inner (and L3 in dark) name no captured use, so not every level is tied to a use.

F13.evidence: core.duration (nine, 40 to 700ms) and core.easing (five cubic-beziers) from the utility classes in use, and core.duration.$extensions.reducedMotion: transitions are motion-safe variants, with the (prefers-reduced-motion) rule counts.

F14.evidence: core.layout: the 1440 x 900 window, the 300px sidebar, composer, settings column, palette, menu, dialog and toast widths, the IDE side bar, the 300px agent pane (inspector), title and status bar heights; core.zIndex layers.

C1.evidence: 17 of the 19 checklist components captured (button, icon button, link, text field, text area, select, checkbox, switch, tabs, menu, tooltip, dialog, toast, card, list row, avatar, badge), plus toolbar, context menu and inspector; radio and table are not present in the product (components.md says what takes their place).

C2.evidence: Hover, focus-visible and pressed are captured per control in both themes (54 state screenshots), plus selected (segments, chips, sidebar and settings rows, palette rows, options), filled (composer, settings search), empty (palette, disabled send) and error surfaces (the warning banner, the error toast, hook errors). Disabled and loading buttons and a field error were not reachable.

C3.evidence: Focus-visible crops exist for icon buttons, composer tools, the mode and capability selects, segments, the account button, switches, the checkbox, settings selects and search, and the ink and outline buttons, in both themes, showing Devin's own 1px accent ring (no switch was flipped to draw it). The sidebar, session and settings-navigation row crops show no ring: the capture focused the row, whose focusable element is the link inside it (README says so).

C4.evidence: components.md writes 2117 of 2453 values as tokens (86%), and component.* in tokens.json aliases 77 to 81 of 82 measured colours per theme.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers the app shell and its two views, starting and following an agent, a cloud session with its PR, settings, menus, dialogs, empty, loading and error states, search, data display and feedback, with screenshots. No validation error was reachable, the destructive confirmation is the workbench's trust dialog standing in, and onboarding is only the empty-state hints.

A1.evidence: Fonts are named with licence and fallback (Inter, SIL OFL, bundled; Devin Mono with its fallback stack; the IDE's Menlo stack). Icons are Devin's inline SVGs and the workbench's codicons, named but not kept or indexed by role (layoutGaps icons/).

K1.evidence: The README says what was captured (both views, both themes, 1440 x 900), how (the debugging port, vars.mjs with the channel probe, utilities.mjs, shots and run), what was changed and put back, and what to distrust (the lingering toast in dark screens, the accent's borrowed hover, redaction).

F16.evidence: Script: 765 of 765 tokens name their source

K2.evidence: Script: 6 rules, each linking a screenshot or crop

Under the mobile wording a system material counts as an elevation level, so Hevy's iOS 26 glass makes elevation apply to it; and a spacing scale whose steps were not read from the product counts as partly.
